raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Couch-to-5K for Exercise-Induced Asthma"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary endurance:
    name "Complete a 5K in 12 weeks with asthma-safe progression"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Intro Run Week 1":
        warmup:
          cardio 10 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Jog 1x1.0 miles rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Walk-Run Progression Week 1":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          walk 2x3 minutes rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          jog 1x1 minute rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          slow_walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 30m "Consistency Week 1":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x2 minutes rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 32m "Intro Run Week 2":
        warmup:
          cardio 10 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x2 minutes rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          walk 1x3 minutes rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 28m "Walk-Run Progression Week 2":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          walk 2x4 minutes rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          jog 1x2 minutes rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          slow_walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 30m "Consistency Week 2":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 3x2 minutes rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 34m "Build Stamina Week 3":
        warmup:
          cardio 10 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 3x2 minutes rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          walk 1x2 minutes rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Walk-Run Week 3":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          walk 3x3 minutes rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          jog 2x1.5 minutes rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          slow_walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 32m "Tempo Prep Week 3":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x3 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          jog 1x2 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 36m "Run-Walk Extends Week 4":
        warmup:
          cardio 12 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 3x3 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walk 2x2 minutes rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 32m "Recovery Run Week 4":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x4 minutes rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          slow_walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 34m "Progress Race Plan Week 4":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x5 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 38m "Baseline Build Week 5":
        warmup:
          cardio 12 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x6 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walk 2x2 minutes rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 34m "Walk-Run Endurance Week 5":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 3x4 minutes rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          walk 2x2 minutes rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          slow_walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 36m "Steady State Prep Week 5":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x6 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Longer Run Week 6":
        warmup:
          cardio 12 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x8 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walk 2x2 minutes rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 36m "Mixed Pace Week 6":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x5 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          jog 1x3 minutes rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          slow_walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 38m "Progression Week 6":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x7 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 42m "Tempo Integration Week 7":
        warmup:
          cardio 12 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 2x6 minutes rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          jog 1x3 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 38m "Endurance Builder Week 7":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 3x5 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          slow_walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Easy Run Week 7":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x8 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 44m "Hill-Prepared Week 8 (gentle stairs optional)":
        warmup:
          cardio 12 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 3x5 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Steady State Week 8":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 4x4 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          slow_walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 42m "Progression Week 8":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x9 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 45m "MN Run Week 9":
        warmup:
          cardio 12 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x10 minutes rpe 6.5 rest 120 seconds
          jog 2x4 minutes rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Varied Pace Week 9":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 3x6 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          slow_walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 45m "Longish Easy Week 9":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x8 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 48m "Base Building Week 10":
        warmup:
          cardio 12 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 2x8 minutes rpe 6.5 rest 120 seconds
          jog 2x4 minutes rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 44m "Midweek Progress Week 10":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 3x6 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          slow_walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 46m "Long Easy Week 10":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x9 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Race Prep Week 11":
        warmup:
          cardio 12 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 3x5 minutes rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          jog 2x3 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 46m "Taper Prep Week 11":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x6 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          slow_walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 48m "Light Day Week 11":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x4 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Final Prep Week 12":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x8 minutes rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Taper Walk Week 12":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          walk 3x2 minutes rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          slow_walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 28m "5K Day Prep Week 12":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x3 minutes rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5 minutes

Notes:
- RPE targets are guidelines to manage asthma triggers; adjust pace to stay within comfortable exertion.
- Always carry quick-relief inhaler and have plan to pause if symptoms arise; warmups are intentionally included to reduce exercise-induced bronchospasm risk.
- If outdoor running is used, avoid cold-air sprints; use warm indoor initiation or wear appropriate layers and nasal breathing where possible.
- If any day is not suitable, substitute with a low-impact alternative (elliptical, cycling) while maintaining total weekly stimulus.
